records.name: Multishot
records.dynamic_description:
Fire multiple arrows at your enemies, each dealing <rt.warning>{Multishot}</> physical damage to them.

When your <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> <rt.effect>Ricochets</> to at least <rt.bold>3 enemies</>, you gain <rt.bold>1 charge</> of <rt.absorb>Multishot</>.

records.name: Deadly Shot (old)
records.description:
Deals 275% Agility damage to target.

Deadly Shot riccochets to all targets with "Marked".

Deals 100% increased damage against targets that have "Exposed Weakness".

Riccochets include damage bonus if the initial target had "Exposed Weakness".

records.name: Focused Shot
records.dynamic_description:
Fire a well-aimed arrow at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{FocusedShot}</> physical damage.

<rt.mana>Generates 20 Focus</>

<rt.mana>FOCUS</>
<rt.mana>Focus</> is a resource shown on the UI under your hero as a bar of celestial energy. Many of your abilities require <rt.mana>Focus</> to use. <rt.mana>Focus</> is passively generated over time. The generation rate is affected by your haste.

records.name: Highwind Arrow
records.dynamic_description:
Fire a <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</>, dealing <rt.warning>{Highwind}</> physical damage to target enemy. <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> <rt.effect>Ricochets</> to up to <rt.bold>2 additional enemies</> near your target, dealing <rt.warning>{HighwindBounceDmg}</> physical damage to them.

<rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

constants.name: Bounce Damage Multiplier after First Hit

records.name: Heartseeker Barrage
records.dynamic_description:
Let loose a barrage of arrows in quick succession at your target, dealing <rt.warning>{HeartSeekDmg}</> physical damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{HeartSeekPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 2 seconds while channeling</>.

Damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Heartseeker Barrage</> that triggers a <rt.effect>Lunarlight Salvo</> has a <rt.bold>25% chance</> to cause it to <rt.effect>Erupt</>, dealing <rt.warning>{AoeLunarLightDmg}</> magic damage to enemies near the target.

<rt.meikoability2>Can not be used while rolling</>

records.name: Roll
records.description:
Swiftly <rt.absorb>Roll</> in the direction you are moving. <rt.absorb>Roll</> does not cancel casting or channeling abilities.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while Casting</>

records.name: Event Horizon (old)
records.description:
The wrath of the stars rains down on your enemies for 12 seconds, causing <rt.absorb>Lunarlight Salvo's</> to hit up to 5 enemies in combat with you every 2 seconds, each dealing <rt.warning>211% Agility</> arcane damage.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Lunarlight Mark
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly apply <rt.bold>3 stacks</> of <rt.absorb>Lunarlight Mark</> to target enemy and up to <rt.bold>11 additional enemies</> near your target.

Ability damage you deal to enemies with <rt.absorb>Lunarlight Mark</> has a <rt.bold>25% chance</> to trigger <rt.effect>Lunarlight Salvo</>, causing a beam of celestial energy to strike them from above, dealing <rt.warning>{LunarSalvoDmg}</> magic damage.

<rt.bold>Critical Strikes</> have a <rt.bold>50% chance</> to trigger <rt.effect>Lunarlight Salvo</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Disrupt
records.description:
Instantly <rt.absorb>Interrupt</> target casting enemy and prevent them from casting for 4 seconds. Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Lunarlight Salvo
records.description: Lunarlight Mark triggered.

records.name: Skystrider's Grace
records.description:
You are granted <rt.warning>+30% Haste</> for <rt.bold>20 seconds</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while Casting or Channeling</>

records.name: Event Horizon
records.description:
The power of the stars flow through you as you prepare to decimate your foes. For the next <rt.bold>20 seconds</>, you deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</>, gain <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste and all <rt.mana>Focus costs are reduced by 50%</>.

While <rt.absorb>Event Horizon</> is active, your <rt.absorb>Highwind Arrow</> reduces the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Heartseeker Barrage</> by <rt.bold>0.5 seconds</>, and every hit from your <rt.absorb>Heartseeker Barrage</> reduces the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Starfall Volley</> by <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.effect> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Skystrider's Supremacy
records.description:
For the next <rt.bold>4 seconds</> you are enraptured in celestial energy, causing your <rt.absorb>Multishot</> ability to shoot <rt.effect>Empowered Multishots</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown.</>

<rt.effect>EMPOWERED MULTISHOT</>
<rt.effect>Empowered Multishots</> always fire at least <rt.bold>3 arrows</> regardless of how many targets are in range, costs <rt.mana>50% less Focus</>, and deals magic damage.

records.name: Celestial Veil
records.description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Celestial Shot
records.dynamic_description:
Fire a magical arrow at target enemy , dealing <rt.warning>{CelestShot}</> magic damage to it.

<rt.effect>CELESTIAL IMPETUS</>
Your <rt.absorb>Focused Shot</> hits have a chance to grant you <rt.effect>Celestial Impetus</> for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>, causing your next <rt.absorb>Celestial Shot</> to be <rt.mana>Free</> and apply <rt.bold>3 stacks</> of <rt.absorb>Lunarlight Mark</> to the target.

You can have up to <rt.bold>2 charges</> of <rt.effect>Celestial Impetus</> at any one time. (2.0 PPM)

records.name: Starfall Volley
records.dynamic_description:
Fire a volley of celestial arrows into the sky that pelt the area around target enemy for <rt.bold>8 seconds</>, dealing <rt.warning>{StarfallDmg}</> magic damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{StarfallPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> to the target and any nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Starfall Volley</> follows the target for its duration.

records.name: Grappling Arrow
records.description:
Fire a <rt.absorb>Grappling Arrow</> at the targeted area. Once the arrow lands, it grapples and <rt.meikoability1>pulls all enemies within 800 radius</> to the arrow's location and reduces their movement speed by 65% for 8 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Infernal Wave
records.dynamic_description:
Conjure a fiery wave to cascade toward your target, dealing <rt.warning>{InfernWaveDirect}</> fire damage.

<rt.mana>Generates 40 Cinders</>.

<rt.mana>CINDERS</>
For every <rt.mana>100 Cinder</> you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Burning Ember</>, shown in the UI below your character as four orbs. Your <rt.mana>Burning Embers</> are used to cast your powerful <rt.absorb>Detonate</> ability.

records.name: Detonate
records.description: Instantly <rt.absorb>Detonate</> all active fire damage over time effects from Ardeos abilities on enemies, dealing damage equal to <rt.warning>3.0 seconds of average ticking damage</> to each enemy.

records.name: Apocalypse
records.dynamic_description: Conjure a major eruption of fire in the targeted area, dealing <rt.warning>{ApocDirect}</> fire damage and applying <rt.absorb>Searing Blaze</> to all enemies in a large radius.

records.name: Searing Blaze
records.dynamic_description:
Target enemy burns for <rt.warning>{SearingBlaze}</> fire damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{EngulfPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 30 seconds</>

<rt.mana>Generates 12 Cinders over its full duration</>.

<rt.mana>CINDERS</>
For every <rt.mana>100 Cinder</> you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Burning Ember</>, shown in the UI below your character as four orbs. Your <rt.mana>Burning Embers</> are used to cast your powerful <rt.absorb>Detonate</> ability.

records.name: Engulfing Flames
records.dynamic_description:
Engulf your target in flames, dealing  <rt.warning>{EngulfingFlames}</> fire damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{EngulfPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 9 seconds</>.

<rt.effect>REKINDLED FLAME</>
Each stack of <rt.absorb>Engulfing Flames</> that is active on an enemy as it dies, grants you <rt.bold>10 seconds</> reduced cooldown on your <rt.absorb>Engulfing Flames</>.

<rt.mana>Generates 30 Cinders over its full duration</>.

<rt.mana>CINDERS</>
For every <rt.mana>100 Cinder</> you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Burning Ember</>, shown in the UI below your character as four orbs. Your <rt.mana>Burning Embers</> are used to cast your powerful <rt.absorb>Detonate</> ability.

records.name: Incinerate
records.dynamic_description:
A jet of fire erupts from your hands as you <rt.bold>channel for 2.5 seconds</>, dealing <rt.warning>{IncinerateDirect}</> fire damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{IncinerateChannelInterval}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> to all enemies in a cone in front of you.

Each hit <rt.effect>extends the duration of your active damage over time effects by 1.5 seconds</> on the targets and applies a stacking damage over time to them dealing <rt.warning>{IncinerateDot}</> fire damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{IncinerateDoTPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 12 seconds</>. The damage over time portion is increased by <rt.warning>+30%</> for each stack that is applied to an enemy.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Flickerstep
records.description:
Instantly teleport forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Fire Frogs
records.dynamic_description:
Conjure five <rt.absorb>Fire Frogs</> to leap at your enemies dealing <rt.warning>{FireFrogDirect}</> fire damage and burning them for an additional <rt.warning>100% of the initial damage dealt</> <rt.bold>over 12 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Fire Frogs'</> damage over time can not critically strike.

Each Fire Frog will perform 3 attacks before dissipating.

records.name: Wildfire
records.description:
All damage over time effects from your hero abilities <rt.warning>tick 30% faster</> for <rt.bold>9 sec</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Pyromania
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly adds an <rt.absorb>Engulfing Flames</> effect on the target, and apply it to up to 2 other nearby enemies. Enemies without an already active <rt.absorb>Engulfing Flames</> and with the highest amount of health will be highest priority.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Fireflash
records.description:
Conjure a bright flash of fire in front of the target's eyes, causing them to become <rt.effect>Disoriented</> for 30 seconds.

<rt.effect>Disorient</>
Disoriented enemies are incapacitated, left to wander around aimlessly for the duration. Any damage dealt to a disoriented enemy will break the effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Scorch
records.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Fire Frogs
records.dynamic_description:
Conjure five <rt.absorb>Fire Frogs</> to leap at your enemies dealing <rt.warning>{FireFrogDirect}</> fire damage and burning them for an additional <rt.warning>100% of the initial damage dealt</> <rt.bold>over 12 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Fire Frogs'</> damage over time can not critically strike.

Each Fire Frog will perform 3 attacks before dissipating.

records.name: Fire Ball
records.dynamic_description: Inflicting fire damage every 2 seconds.

records.name: Fire Ball
records.dynamic_description:
Throw a ball of fiery devestation at the targeted area, dealing <rt.warning>{FireBallDirect}</> fire damage to all enemies in the radius and setting them on fire, dealing an additional <rt.warning>20% of the initial damage dealt</> <rt.bold>over 12 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Fire Ball's</> damage over time can not critically strike.

Your Haste is also applied as <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> on <rt.absorb>Fire Ball</>.

<rt.mana>Each tick of Fireball has a 50% chance to generate 2 Cinders</>.

<rt.mana>CINDERS</>
For every <rt.mana>100 Cinder</> you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Burning Ember</>, shown in the UI below your character as four orbs. Your <rt.mana>Burning Embers</> are used to cast your powerful <rt.absorb>Detonate</> ability.

records.description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Double Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Strike the target enemy with both axes in swift succession, dealing {DoubleStrikeDmg} per hit.

<rt.absorb>Double Strike</> can be used both in melee and at range.

Applies <rt.warning>Rend</> to the target for {Rend} of the damage dealt.

records.name: Reckless Abandon
records.dynamic_description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Warbound
records.dynamic_description: Quickly leap in the direction you are moving, dealing {WarboundDmg} to all enemies in your path.

records.name: Owed in Blood
records.dynamic_description:
Each time <rt.warning>Rend</> deals damage there is a chance a <rt.effect>Blood Feather</> is spawned near the enemy on the ground that you can pick up to gain 1 stack of <rt.effect>Owed in Blood</> for 30 seconds, up to maximum of 150 stacks.

Enemies that die with your <rt.warning>Rend</> active on them have a 25% chance to create a <rt.effect>Blood Feather</>.

When you use your <rt.absorb>Owed in Blood</> ability, all stacks of <rt.effect>Owed in Blood</> you have accumulated from <rt.effect>Blood Feathers</> are applied to the targeted enemy as <rt.warning>Rend</> stacks.

records.name: Bloodbound Spirit
records.dynamic_description:
Call forth your <rt.absorb>Bloodbound Spirit</>, dealing <rt.warning>{BloodboundSpiritDmg}</> magic damage to all nearby enemies as it emerges and every <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</> for <rt.bold>6 seconds</>, applying <rt.warning>Rend</> to the targets for <rt.warning>{Rend} of the damage dealt</>.

For the next <rt.bold>20 seconds</> your <rt.absorb>Heart Splitter</> and <rt.absorb>Grim Carve</> deal <rt.warning>{BloodboundBuff} increased damage</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 seconds.</>

records.name: Reign in Blood
records.dynamic_description: For the next {duration}, your abilities apply an additional <rt.warning>{AddedTransfer} of the damage dealt</> to <rt.warning>Rend</>.

records.name: Heart Splitter
records.dynamic_description:
Jump and strike at your enemy from above, dealing {ReckoningDmg} to the target.

<rt.warning>100%</> of the direct damage dealt by <rt.absorb>Heart Splitter</> is added to <rt.warning>Rend</>.

<rt.effect>Exsanguinate</>
<rt.absorb>Heart Splitter</> exsanguinates the target's wounds, dealing an additional <rt.warning>{BonusOfRend}</> of the <rt.warning>Total Rend Damage</> active on the target.

records.name: Rupture
records.dynamic_description:
Strike target enemy by driving both axes upwards through their torso and splitting their anatomy open, dealing {RuptureDmg} and applying <rt.effect>Open Wounds</> for <rt.bold>18 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Rupture</> applies <rt.warning>Rend</> to the target for {Rend} of the damage dealt.

<rt.effect>Open Wounds</>
Your next <rt.absorb>Slaughter</> consumes <rt.effect>Open Wounds</>, <rt.warning>increasing</> <rt.absorb>Slaughter's</> <rt.warning>damage against that enemy by 20%</>.

records.name: Slaughter
records.dynamic_description:
Strike with immense power around you, consuming all <rt.warning>Rend</> stacks on enemies hit and applying <rt.effect>Slaughter</> to them.

<rt.effect>Slaughter</> is a bleed that deals <rt.warning>{Slaughter} of the total Rend damage</> consumed from each enemy, to each enemy over <rt.bold>3 seconds</>.

records.name: Blood Arc
records.dynamic_description:
Cleave all enemies in front of you, dealing {BloodArcDmg} and granting you <rt.effect>Serrated Edge</> for 10 seconds, causing your next damaging ability to transfer an additional <rt.warning>20%</> of its damage to <rt.warning>Rend</>.

<rt.effect>Serrated Edge</> does not interact with your <rt.absorb>Bloodbound Spirit</> ability.

<rt.absorb>Blood Arc</> applies <rt.warning>Rend</> to the targets for {Rend} of the damage dealt.

records.name: Reaver's Edge
records.dynamic_description:
Jump into a spinning strike, dealing {ReaversEdgeDmg} to all nearby enemies.

Applies <rt.warning>Rend</> to the targets for {Rend} of the damage dealt.

records.description: Leap to target location

<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Butcher's Hook
records.dynamic_description:
Throw a chained axe at target enemy, dealing {ButchersHookDmg} and pulling them to you.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Owed in Blood
records.dynamic_description:
Consumes <rt.warning>Rend</> on all nearby targets and applies "<rt.absorb>Owed in Blood</>" buff on you for 10 seconds.
When used again, applies the "Saved Rend" (<rt.absorb>Owed in Blood</> buff) on the new target.

records.name: Grim Carve
records.dynamic_description:
Throw your axe at the target enemy, where it spins like a sawblade, hitting all nearby enemies three times and dealing {GrimCarveDmg} with each spin.

Applies <rt.warning>Rend</> to the targets for {Rend} of the damage dealt.

records.name: Hammer Storm
records.dynamic_description:
Spin with your Hammer <rt.warning>up to 3 times</>, dealing <rt.warning>{HamrStormTickDmg}</> physical damage to all nearby enemies <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{HamrStormPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> deals <rt.warning>35% more damage</> with each spin.

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
<rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> causes lightning to strike you as you spin, shocking enemies for an additional <rt.warning>{HamrStormLightningDmg}</> lightning damage each time they are hit.

records.name: Intimidate
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly <rt.effect>Intimidate</> up to 40 nearby enemies, causing them to cower in place for <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

If an enemy afflicted by <rt.effect>Intimidate</> takes damage equal to <rt.warning>{IntimidateDmgBreak}</>, they will break out of the effect. (Strength scaled)

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Heavy Strike
records.dynamic_description:
When the <rt.meikoability2>Swing Timer</> is in the red, <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> instantly smashes the target for <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeDmg}</> physical damage and deals <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeClvDmg}</> physical damage to all enemies near the target.

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> also charges the ground in front of you with lightning, dealing <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeLightnDmg}</> lightning damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.mana>Generates Fury relative to damage dealt if used in hit window</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be queued during Global Cooldown</>


<rt.meikoability2>Swing Timer</>
Your swing timer is displayed as a bar to the right of your hero. When you see the red area light up on the swing timer it is time to queue your <rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> and wait for it to finish.

<rt.meikoability2>Queueing Heavy Strike</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike's</> queue is displayed as a golden border around the ability icon on your action bar. The queue is canceled when you use any other ability, so make sure the last button you press before the swing timer reaches the end of the red area is Heavy Strike.

records.name: Heavy Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly smash the target for <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeDmg}</> physical damage and deal <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeClvDmg}</> physical damage to all enemies near the target.

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
<rt.absorb>Heavy Strike</> also charges the ground in front of you with lightning, dealing <rt.warning>{HeavyStrikeLightnDmg}</> lightning damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.mana>Generates 12 Fury</>

records.name: Chain Lightning
records.dynamic_description:
Conjure an arc of lightning onto target enemy that chains between you and other enemies until it has <rt.warning>dealt damage a total of 6 times</>. Each hit of <rt.absorb>Chain Lightning</> deals <rt.warning>{ChainLightDmg}</> lightning damage.

<rt.absorb>Chain Lightning</> does not deal damage to you.

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
You can only cast <rt.absorb>Chain Lightning</> while <rt.effect>Thunder Call</> is active.

<rt.mana>Generates 1.2 Fury per hit</>

records.name: Thunder Call
records.description:
Call on thunder to charge your hammer with immense power, <rt.effect>enhancing your abilities for 21 seconds</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Wild Swing
records.dynamic_description:
Swing your hammer in a wide arc toward target enemy dealing <rt.warning>{WildSwingDmg}</> physical damage to it and any nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Recklessness</>
- Enemies have an increased chance to <rt.bold>Dodge</> <rt.absorb>Wild Swing</>.
- Wild Swing cannot critically strike.
- The damage of <rt.absorb>Wild Swing</> is increased by an amount equal to your critical strike chance percentage.

<rt.mana>Generates 3 Fury</>

records.name: Focused Wrath
records.description:
Your next two casts of <rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> or <rt.absorb>Hammer Storm</> cost <rt.mana>52% less Fury</> and deal <rt.warning>10% more damage</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Raging Tempest
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly Leap to target area and smash the ground, dealing <rt.warning>{TempestLeapDmg}</> lightning damage to all nearby enemies.You also gain an <rt.effect>Enhanced Thunder Call</> for 20 seconds that causes you to release <rt.effect>Raging Currents</> at enemies over time.

<rt.effect>Raging Currents</>
Strike a random nearby enemy <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{RagingCurPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> with lightning, dealing <rt.warning>{RagingCurDmg}</> lightning damage with each strike. Each time <rt.effect>Raging Currents</> hits an enemy your <rt.bold>Expertise is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Skull Crusher
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly deal <rt.warning>{SkullCrushDmg}</> physical damage to target enemy.

<rt.meikoability2>Skull Crusher triggers a shortened Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>Thunder Call</>
<rt.absorb>Skull Crusher</> beckons a thunder bolt to strike the target from above, dealing <rt.warning>{SkullCrushLightnDmg}</> lightning damage.

records.name: Culling Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly deal <rt.warning>{CullStrikeDmg}</> physical damage to target enemy. <rt.absorb>Culling Strike</> spends up to <rt.mana>10 Fury</>, <rt.warning>increasing the damage it deals by up to 400%</>. The more <rt.mana>Fury</> it consumes, the higher the damage it deals.

<rt.absorb>Execution</>
Can only be used against enemies that have 30% or less health.

records.name: Pummel
records.description:
Instantly interrupt target enemy's spell cast, and silence them for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Leap Smash
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly Leap to target area and smash the ground, dealing <rt.warning>{LeapSmashDmg}</> physical damage to all nearby enemies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.dynamic_description:
Instantly attack target enemy dealing <rt.warning>{FaceBreakDmg}</> physical damage.

<rt.meikoability2>Face Breaker resets the Swing Timer</>

<rt.effect>Flash of Anger</>
Whenever one of your attacks <rt.bold>Misses</> or is <rt.bold>Dodged</> by an enemy, you gain <rt.effect>Flash of Anger</>, causing your next <rt.absorb>Face Breaker</> to <rt.bold>not trigger it's cooldown</>, <rt.meikoability2>not reset the Swing Timer</> and deal <rt.warning>+400% increased damage</>.

<rt.mana>Generates 6 Fury plus an amount based on the total damage it dealt</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.absorb>Face Breaker</> deals <rt.warning>50% of its damage to enemies near your target</>.

<rt.mana>Generates 7 Fury</>

records.name: Taunt
records.description:
Taunt target enemy, forcing it to attack you for 6 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Restore Continuity
records.dynamic_description:

Every 2 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> releases a pulse, healing all allies within 4000 radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts 16 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> spawns <rt.effect>3 Boomshrooms</> when it withers.

records.name: Shroomsplosion
records.dynamic_description:
Command all mature <rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</> to attack causing them to leap at target enemy and explode, dealing <rt.warning>{ShroomSplDmg}</> magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</>
Each time one of your plants expire, budding <rt.absorb>Boomshrooms</> start growing in that location. After 3 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Boomshroom</> has reached full maturity and is ready to be called into battle.

records.name: Life Petal
records.dynamic_description:
A <rt.absorb>Life Petal</> sprouts up near you, healing one ally for {LifePetalTickHeal} <rt.bold>every</> <rt.heal>{LifePetalPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> for 14 seconds, preferring the ally with the lowest health.

<rt.absorb>Life Petal's</> healing wanes over time, healing for less the longer it has been active.

<rt.absorb>Life Petal</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.absorb>Life Petal</> spawns <rt.effect>2 Boomshrooms</> when it withers.

records.name: Hidden Trail
records.description:
Your Movement Speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Demure</>
Upon activating <rt.absorb>Hidden Trail</> your threat is reduced by 50% with all enemies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Fluttercall: Restore Life
records.dynamic_description:
Beckon two <rt.meikoability1>Pink Flutterflies</> to dance around target ally. <rt.bold>After</> <rt.heal>{RestoreLifeDelay}</> <rt.bold>seconds</>, the target is instantly healed for {RestoreLifeDirectHeal} plus an additional {RestoreLifeHotHeal} <rt.bold>every</> <rt.heal>{RestoreLifeHotPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> for 15 seconds.

All healing done by <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> counts as <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.

records.name: Fluttercall: Heal
records.dynamic_description:
Assign one of your <rt.meikoability1>Pink Flutterflies</> to an ally, healing them for {FlutterHeal} <rt.bold>every</> <rt.heal>{FlutterHealPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</> until it is called away.

All healing done by <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> counts as <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.

records.name: Safe Haven
records.description: Place a <rt.absorb>Safe Haven</> in target location. For the next 15 seconds, all allies standing within the radius have <rt.absorb>40% increased healing taken</>.

records.name: Prickly Vine
records.dynamic_description:
Summon a <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> for 27 seconds to continuously fling thorns at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{PricklyVineDmg}</> magic damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{PricklyVinePeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds</>.

For each <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> you have active, all <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> is <rt.heal>increased by 3%</>.

<rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> deal increased damage equal to your Haste.

Each <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> spawns <rt.effect>1 Boomshroom</> when it withers.

records.name: Fluttercall: Jubilee
records.description:
Call upon <rt.bold>Dream Flutterflies</> to protect up to 4 players by evenly distributing all health between them every 1.5 seconds over 12 sec.

Upon arriving, the <rt.bold>Dream Flutterflies</> cause <rt.absorb>6 Prickly Vines</> to spontaneously  spawn near you.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Ironleaf Ward
records.description:
Target ally takes <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Cure Ailment
records.description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.

records.name: Enfeebling Rootsap
records.description:
Command one of your <rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> to <rt.effect>Enfeeble</> target enemy, reducing all damage that enemy deals by 20% for 10 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown.</>

The <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> withers upon completing it's cast of <rt.absorb>Enfeebling Rootsap</>.

records.name: Ice Blitz
records.description:
You enter a state of focused casting for 20 seconds, causing you to deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</> for the duration.

The duration of <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</> is extended by 0.1 seconds each time a <rt.absorb>Frost Swallow</> hits an enemy.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting</>

records.name: Bursting Ice
records.dynamic_description:
Conjures an icy crystal inside a target that pulses frost damage, dealing <rt.warning>{BurstIceTickDmg}</> <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{BurstIcePeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 3 seconds</> to the target and nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</>
While <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> is active on an enemy you gain <rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</>, causing you to deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</>. <rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</> does not affect <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</>.

<rt.mana>Each pulse of</> <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> <rt.mana>Generates 1 Anima</>

<rt.mana>ANIMA</>
Your <rt.mana>Anima</> is shown as a bar beneath your character. For every 9 Anima you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>, used to cast your powerful spender abilities.

records.name: Frost Bolt
records.dynamic_description:
Hurl a bolt of frost magic at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{FrostBolt}</> damage.

<rt.mana>Generates 3 Anima</> 

<rt.mana>ANIMA</>
Your <rt.mana>Anima</> is shown as a bar beneath your character. For every 9 Anima you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>, used to cast your powerful spender abilities.

records.name: Glacial Blast
records.dynamic_description: Hurl a mass of ice at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{GlacialBlast}</> damage.

records.name: Freezing Torrent
records.dynamic_description:
Flay your target with a beam of frost energy, dealing <rt.warning>{FreezeTorrTickDmg}</> damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{FreezeTorrPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds for 2 seconds</> while channeling. 

<rt.mana>Generates 1 Anima per tick</>

<rt.mana>ANIMA</>
Your <rt.mana>Anima</> is shown as a bar beneath your character. For every 9 Anima you generate, you gain <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</>, used to cast your powerful spender abilities.

records.name: Winter's Blessing
records.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Spirit is increased by 20%</> for 20 seconds and <rt.heal>30% of all damage you deal is replicated as healing</> divided equally between all allies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Ice Dash
records.description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Wrath of Winter
records.description:
Invoke the spirits of the frozen tundra for 20 seconds, granting you <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</> every 4 seconds. You deal <rt.warning>+20% increased damage</> and your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> ability is instant cast while <rt.absorb>Wrath of Winter</> is active.

<rt.mana>WINTER ORBS</>
<rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> are required to cast your powerful spender abilities; <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> and <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</>.

<rt.effect>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Frost Swallows
records.dynamic_description: Rime commands Frost Swallows to attack her target.

records.name: Frigid Winds
records.description:
Blast enemies in front of you with arctic winds, <rt.absorb>Knocking Back</> enemies and <rt.absorb>Slowing</> them by 50% for 12 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Cold Snap
records.dynamic_description:
Assault the target with extreme cold, dealing <rt.warning>{ColdSnap}</> damage. 

<rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.mana>Generates 1 Winter Orb</>

<rt.mana>WINTER ORBS</>
<rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> are required to cast your powerful spender abilities; <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</>, <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</>, and <rt.absorb>Flight of the Navir</>.

records.name: Brain Freeze
records.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Ice Comet
records.dynamic_description: Unleash a large <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> from above target enemy to crash down on them, dealing <rt.warning>{IceComet}</> damage to all enemies caught in the impact radius.

records.name: Frost Ward
records.description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Rising Talons
records.dynamic_description:
Unleash mutliple <rt.absorb>Ice Talon</>s, per used Winter Orb, on the target enemy and all nearby targets, dealing <rt.warning>{Talons}</> damage per target.

Costs all Winter Orbs.

records.name: Talon Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Unleash one huge <rt.absorb>Ice Talon</>, per used Winter Orb used, on the target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{Talons}</> damage.

Costs all Winter Orbs.

records.name: Flight of the Navir
records.dynamic_description:
Summon <rt.effect>5 Frost Swallows</> to circle above Rime for 20 seconds. Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> and <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> command the frost swallows to swoop down on enemies, each dealing <rt.warning>{FrostSwallDmg}</> damage to their target.

<rt.bold>For every 1% Spirit you have</>, your <rt.absorb>Frost Swallows</> deal <rt.warning>1.5% more damage</>.

<rt.greyitalic>"She needed only whisper, and the Navir appeared."</>

records.name: Omnistrike
records.dynamic_description:
Swing your sword in a large arc around you, dealing <rt.warning>{OmnistrikeDmg}</> physical damage to all enemies around you.

<rt.mana>Generates 4 Spirit Points</>.

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Omnistrike</> has a 30% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.

records.name: Solar Blades
records.dynamic_description:
Conjure blades of pure sunlight to fall from above upon your target, dealing <rt.warning>{SolarBladesDmg}</> magical damage to it and other enemies within a 700 radius.

The main target takes <rt.warning>100% more damage</> from <rt.absorb>Solar Blades</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Solar Blades</> has a 100% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.

records.name: Omega Reprieval
records.description:
Instantly gain 2 stacks of <rt.effect>Omega Reprieval</>, causing your <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> with <rt.bold>added enhancements</> when used to consume the 2 stacks.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>Brilliant Flash: Enhanced</>
Your <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> has <rt.warning>50% increased power</> on your <rt.bold>Main Target</> and <rt.mana>generates 12% maximum Mana</> for you.

When cast on a friendly target, <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> is also casted on <rt.bold>all party members</> within a large range of that ally.

When cast on an enemy, <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> is also casted on <rt.bold>all enemies</> within a large range of that enemy.

<rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> consumes 1 stack of <rt.effect>Omega Reprieval</>.

records.name: Brilliant Flare
records.dynamic_description:
Heal target ally for {BrillFlareHeal} health.

<rt.effect>BRILLIANT FLASH</>
When you have a charge of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</> or <rt.effect>Omega Reprieval</> your <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> turns into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.

records.name: Aura of Solace
records.dynamic_description:
Burns all enemies within a large radius for <rt.warning>{SolaceDmg}</> magical damage every <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</> while active and increases your <rt.bold>Parry chance by +8%</>

<rt.absorb>Aura of Solace</> transfers <rt.heal>10% of all damage taken by nearby allies to you</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.mana>Costs 10 Mana every 1.5 seconds while active.</>

records.name: Shining Halo
records.dynamic_description:
Sunlight envelopes the ground at your feet, burning enemies within its area for <rt.warning>{ShiningHaloDmg}</> magical damage every <rt.bold>1.5 seconds</> over <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

You take <rt.heal>20% reduced damage</> while standing in your <rt.absorb>Shining Halo</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>BRILLIANCE</>
While <rt.absorb>Shining Halo</> is active, each <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> you cast extends the duration of it by <rt.bold>2 seconds</>.

records.name: Blinding Slash
records.dynamic_description:
Your sword is infused with the light of sun power as you slash at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{BlindSlashDmg}</> physical damage to them and other enemies near it.

<rt.effect>BLIND</>
You apply 1 stack of <rt.effect>Blind</> to enemies hit by <rt.absorb>Blinding Slash</> for up to 8 seconds, causing their Auto Attacks to have an additional <rt.bold>+20% chance to be Parried by you</>. Each time you Parry an enemy, 1 stack of <rt.effect>Blind</> is consumed on that enemy.

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Blinding Slash</> has a 15% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.

records.name: Ruptured Dawn
records.dynamic_description:
Rupture the ground in front of you,  dealing <rt.warning>{RisingSunDmg}</> magical damage to all enemies in a cone in front of you, <rt.effect>Stunning</> them for 2 seconds and <rt.effect>Pulling</> them to you.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Brilliant Flash
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly heal target ally for {BrillFlashHeal} health or deal <rt.warning>{BrillFlashDmg}</> damage to target enemy.

When you target an enemy with <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>, you also heal yourself for {BrillFlashHeal} health.

In all situations, <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> heals you for 20% more than others.

<rt.effect>BRILLIANT SPIRIT</>
<rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</> has a chance equal to your <rt.bold>Spirit %</> to trigger a <rt.mana>Spirit Refund</>. When it does, you gain <rt.mana>50 Mana</> instantly, in addition to all other effects that are normally activated upon triggering a <rt.mana>Spirit Refund</>.

records.name: Decree of the Sun
records.dynamic_description:
Envelope yourself in solar power, making you <rt.effect>Immune to all damage for 3 seconds</>, ending with an explosion of light that deals <rt.warning>{DecreeSunAoeDmg}</> magical damage to nearby enemies.

Once the immunity fades, you take <rt.heal>50% reduced damage</> for another 5 seconds.

During <rt.absorb>Decree of the Sun</> you radiate solar magic in the area, healing nearby players for {DecreeSunHeal} every second.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Solar Shield
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly shield the target, absorbing up to <rt.heal>{SolarShldAbsrb} damage</>. The shield lasts for up to 8 seconds.

All damage dealt to <rt.absorb>Solar Shield</> is reduced by <rt.heal>50%</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: (OLD) Gift of Solace
records.description: For the next 8 seconds, 50% of all damage taken by target ally is transferred to you

records.name: Sun Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Strike your target, dealing <rt.warning>{SunstrikeDmg}</> physical damage to it as well as striking enemies near your target with <rt.warning>15% of the power</>.

<rt.absorb>Sun Strike</> applies <rt.effect>Sunstruck</> to your main target for 30 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

<rt.effect>SUNSTRUCK</>
your next <rt.absorb>Omnistrike</> consumes all stacks of <rt.effect>Sunstruck</> on all targets hit, replenishing <rt.mana>100 Mana</> plus an additional <rt.mana>50 Mana for each stack beyond the first that is consumed</>.

<rt.effect>SWIFT REPRIEVAL</>
<rt.absorb>Sun Strike</> has a 15% chance to grant you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Swift Reprieval</>, causing <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flare</> to turn into <rt.absorb>Brilliant Flash</>.

records.name: Interrupt
records.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 

Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Taunt
records.description:
<rt.absorb>Taunt</> the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: (OLD) Brilliant Flash
records.description: Heal yourself or targeted ally for 1634% Strength - OR deal 623% Strength damage to target enemy.

records.name: Sky Crash
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly ascend to the skies in a beam of light and crash down at the targeted location, dealing <rt.warning>{SkycrashDamage}</> magical damage to enemies in the area.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Dawnflare
records.dynamic_description:
Deals <rt.warning>{DawnflareDmg}</> magic damage to target enemy.

Each cast of <rt.absorb>Dawnflare</> generates <rt.mana>20% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour can call upon the light to unleash a flare of divine light from above. This flash of radiant energy strikes the enemy with a sharp but controlled force.</>

records.name: Greater Heal
records.dynamic_description:
Heal target ally for {GreaterHeal}.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour opens his sacred tome, drawing forth radiant power inscribed within its pages. With a solemn gesture, he calls forth a burst of healing energy to mend even the deepest wounds.</>

records.name: Levitate
records.description:
Your movement speed is increased by 70% for 5 seconds and you take <rt.bold>40% reduced Area of Effect damage</> for the duration.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while Casting or Channeling</>

records.name: Lightshaper's Ward
records.description:
Target ally takes <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Circle of Light
records.dynamic_description:
Place a <rt.bold>Circle of Light</> on the ground, instantly healing all allies within its radius for {CircLightHeal}.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour calls upon the power of light to create a circle of divine healing on the ground. Allies within its boundaries are restored in a sudden flash, as the light pours into them, mending their wounds.</>

records.name: Radiant Blast
records.dynamic_description:
Within a cone in front of you, allies are healed for {RadiantBlastHeal} and enemies take <rt.warning>{RadiantBlastDmg}</> magic damage.

When <rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</> deals damage to any number of enemies, it generates <rt.mana>30% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour expels an explosive flash of divine light from his outstretched hand, healing allies in its path, while searing enemies with its blinding brilliance.</>

records.name: Runic Proliferation
records.description:
Instantly generate <rt.mana>3 Radiant Runes</>. For the next 8 seconds, any <rt.absorb>Rune Abilities</> you cast are empowered, increasing their effectiveness by 20%.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Avatar of Light
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly heal all allies within a large radius of you for {AvatarDirectHeal} and enter an enlightened state for 9 sec, enhancing your abilities.

<rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</>
Deals <rt.warning>50% increased damage</> and has no <bold>Cooldown</>.

<rt.absorb>Heal</>
Costs <rt.mana>50% less Mana</> and is <rt.bold>Instant Cast</>.

<rt.absorb>Circle of Light</>
Costs <rt.mana>50% less Mana</> and has no <bold>Cooldown</>.


<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Throw Book
records.description:
Educate a target, <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 2 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Remove Magic
records.description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.

records.name: Luminous Barrier
records.dynamic_description:
Apply a shield to target ally that absorbs up to <rt.heal>{LuminousAbsorb}</> damage. <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> lasts for up to <rt.bold>12 seconds</>.

Damage absorbed by <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> is <rt.heal>reduced by {LuminousDmgRed}</>.

<rt.effect>RESIDUAL LUMINOSITY</>
When <rt.absorb>Luminous Barrier</> expires or is removed from a player, they gain <rt.effect>Residual Luminosity</> for <rt.bold>15 seconds</>, <rt.heal>reducing all damage taken by 15%</>.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>.

records.name: Rune of Renewal
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly heal target ally for {RenewalHealDirect} and apply <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> on them for 30 seconds, causing all your direct healing effects on that ally to echo for an additional <rt.heal>35% of the initial heal's value</>.

The bonus healing generated by <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> generates <rt.mana>Radiant Rune</> resource relative to the value of the heal.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a resonating rune onto the spirit of an ally. When Vigor heals that ally, the rune pulses gently, further mending any wounds that linger as its light nourishes the body and spirit.</>

records.name: Soulbrand
records.dynamic_description:
Apply a searing rune to target enemy, instantly dealing <rt.warning>{RemnantDamage}</> magic damage to them, plus an additional <rt.warning>{SoulbrandTickDmg}</> magic damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{SoulbrandPeriod}</> <rt.bold>seconds over 24 seconds</>.

<rt.absorb>Soulbrand</> generates <rt.mana>30% of a Radiant Rune</> and <rt.mana>1% Maximum Mana</> over its duration.

<rt.effect>GRAND DESIGN</>
<rt.bold>Hold down the ability button</> until a cast bar is displayed to cast this ability on up to 4 targets at 60% power. Requires <rt.mana>2 Radiant Runes</>. 

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour inscribes a searing rune onto the soul of his enemy, infusing it with radiant energy. The rune pulses painfully, steadily draining their life force while fueling Vigour’s power.</>

records.name: Dawnbreaker Orb
records.dynamic_description:
Conjure an orb of light that slowly travels forward, healing all allies it touches for {DawnOrbHeal} and damaging enemies for <rt.warning>{DawnOrbDmg}</>. The power of <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb's</> damage and healing is affected by the target's maximum health. The higher maximum health the target has, the more damage or healing it does.

Each ally and enemy touched by <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb</> generates <rt.mana>8% of a Radiant Rune</>.

<rt.greyitalic>Vigour conjures an orb of intricate runes, humming with radiant power. The orb shines brilliantly as it slowly drifts forward, burning all darkness from its path and bolstering the lifeforce of Vigour's allies.</>

records.name: Grand Melee
records.description:
For the next 10 seconds, <rt.effect>Incite</> all enemies in a large radius around you, forcing them to only use <bold>Auto Attacks</> and only attack you.

All allies within the radius of <rt.absorb>Grand Melee</> take <rt.effect>20% reduced magic damage</> while it is active.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Shield Throw
records.dynamic_description:
Throw your shield at target enemy dealing <rt.warning>{ShieldThrwDirect}</> physical damage. The shield bounces to up to 5 additional nearby enemies.

Each time <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> deals damage it generates <rt.mana>Toughness relative to the damage dealt</>.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> ability by 3.0 seconds.

records.name: Shields Up
records.dynamic_description:
Raise your shield, increasing your <rt.mana>Toughness by 30%</> and increasing your <rt.meikoability1>Block chance by 25%</> for 12 sec.

<rt.absorb>Shields Up</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.meikoability1>Each time you succesfully Block an attack, you generate</> <rt.mana>3% Toughness</>.

<rt.mana>TOUGHNESS</>
<rt.mana>Toughness</> is displayed as a bar to the right of your character. The more Toughness you have, the less damage Helena takes. Your <rt.mana>maximum Toughness value (</><rt.heal>{MaxToughness}</><rt.mana>) is equal to {StrCoefficient} strength. Every 1% of Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit you have further increases the final amount by 2%</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Power Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Perform a heavy strike, dealing <rt.warning>{PwrStrkDirect}</> physical damage to target.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Power Strike</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> and <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> abilities by 2 seconds.

records.name: Sweeping Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Deals <rt.warning>{SweepStrkDirect}</> physical damage to your target and other nearby enemies and grants you <rt.effect>Blood Rally</> for {BloodRushDuration} seconds, <rt.heal>healing you for {BloodRushHeal} of your maximum Health every {BloodRushPeriod}</>.

Enemies hit by <rt.absorb>Sweeping Strike</> bleed for <rt.warning>{SweepStrikDot}</> physical damage <rt.bold>every</> <rt.warning>{SweepStrikePeriod}</><rt.bold> seconds for 12 seconds</>.

records.name: Measured Strike
records.dynamic_description:
Strike target enemy with your sword, dealing <rt.warning>{MeaStrikeDirect}</> physical damage to them and nearby enemies.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Measured Strike</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> and <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> abilities by 2 seconds.

records.name: Shockwave
records.dynamic_description:
Slam sword and shield together creating a forceful explosion, dealing <rt.warning>{ShockwaveDirect}</> physical damage to enemies in a large radius.

Enemies that take damage from <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> have <rt.effect>reduced movement speed</> for 5 seconds, starting at 90% and dimishing by 10% every 0.5 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Shockwave</> generates <rt.mana>25% Toughness</>.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Shockwave</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shields Up</> ability by 6 seconds.

records.name: Shield Slam
records.dynamic_description:
Deals <rt.warning>{ShieldSlamDirect}</> physical damage to your target and <rt.warning>{ShieldSlamCleave}</> physical damage to other enemies near your target.

<rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> gains <rt.meikoability2>Cooldown Acceleration</> equal to your Haste.

<rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> generates <rt.mana>15% Toughness</>.

<rt.effect>LINGERING CONCUSSION</>
<rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> applies <rt.effect>Lingering Concussion</> to your main target, causing them to deal <rt.heal>3% reduced damage to you for 12 seconds</>. <rt.effect>Lingering Concussion</> stacks up to 5 times.

<rt.mana>TOUGHNESS</>
<rt.mana>Toughness</> is displayed as a bar to the right of your character. The more Toughness you have, the less damage Helena takes. Your <rt.mana>maximum Toughness value (</><rt.heal>{MaxToughness}</><rt.mana>) is equal to {StrCoefficient} strength. Every 1% of Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise, and Spirit you have further increases the final amount by 2%</>.

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> ability by 3.0 seconds.

records.name: Bash
records.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Hold the Line
records.dynamic_description:
Instantly resets the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> ability and causes your next <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> within 12 seconds to be <rt.effect>Empowered</>.

<rt.effect>Empowered Shield Slam</>
Your next <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> applies a barrier on you, absorbing up to <rt.heal>{ShieldSlamAbsrb}</> damage taken for 8 seconds. Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> is not reduced while the barrier is active.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.effect>VETERAN OF WAR</>
<rt.absorb>Hold the Line</> reduces the cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</>, <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</>, <rt.absorb>Shields Up</>, and <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> abilities by 10 seconds.

records.name: Charge
records.dynamic_description: Charge at target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>{ChargeDirect}</> physical damage and <rt.effect>Stunning</> them for 2 seconds.

records.name: Iron Wall
records.description:
Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> can not be reduced for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Taunt
records.description:
<rt.absorb>Taunt</> the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

records.name: Siegebreaker
records.description:
For the next 20 seconds, the cooldown reduction granted by your <rt.effect>Veteran of War</> is doubled.

While <rt.absorb>Siegebreaker</>is active, you take 25% reduced damage and your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</>, <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> and <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> abilities deal 25% increased damage.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

records.name: Fire Ball
records.dynamic_description: Inflicting fire damage every 2 seconds.
